notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Fixed a major issue that caused the game to suddenly freeze when picking up a System Memory Leak
 Fixed a bug that caused duplicated system memory leaks in the DataLog
 Fixed a bug that caused the System Memory Leaks to be badly selected across levels
 Fixed a bug that caused the game not to display the score screen correctly in certain situations
 Slightly increased the parry window
 Tuned the obtainable score in the SRAM, CPU_A and CPU_B levels 
 Fixed some collisions and mesh positioning in the Training sector 23a, Capacitor sector, IO_Board_B, IO_Board_C, Data Buffer, SRAM and CPU_B levels
 Changed the level entrance for the CPU_A level
 Improved some italian translations


IMPORTANT NOTICE:

To be able to correctly obtain all the System Memory Leaks now and without duplicates, a reset of the savefile is unfortunately needed by starting a new game.

We deeply apologize for this and the disease it may have caused.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Steam Demo + Release Period
notes.notes:
Hello malware, a demo of OveRRooT is now available on Steam!

OveRRooT is an Action Platformer, where you control Root, a sophisticated malware created with a sole objective: bypass the defenses of malfunctioning computer systems by erasing their cyberspace, in order to reset them to their default state and bring them back to life again.

Now it's time for you to take on a new job, in a new system. Nothing more than just the same old routine... probably.

It is developed by Hexagony and will be released on Summer 2024 (Q3).

Watch the newest trailer on Youtube and join our Discord to leave feedback on the demo!
